name: top_p_renorm
description: Top-p (nucleus) renormalization. probs is [batch, vocab] of nonnegative probabilities; top_p may be a Python scalar, a single-element tensor, or a per-row tensor. For each row, sort probabilities ascending, form their cumulative sum, find the cutoff at cumulative mass 1-p, take the value at that cutoff as the pivot, keep every entry >= pivot (including ties), and normalize kept entries by their sum. Returns a newly allocated float32 [batch, vocab] tensor; probs is not modified. The native kernel performs a vectorized threshold search and stores the normalized result into a fresh output. Suites exercise float32 probs/scalars and a per-row top_p tensor.
